content:
olivia: FYI CuraMap invoice invoice_7842 failed — card decline 'do_not_honor'. Customer called, says card is valid but wants to switch to ACH instead.
kevin: looking into gateway logs now. I see 3 attempts yesterday with response do_not_honor then soft_decline.
olivia: customer says their payables tried to add ACH but microdeposit failed with 'account_type_mismatch' (they used checking/incorrect routing?).
finance-bot: Payment alert: invoice_7842 | status: FAILED | attempts: 3. Recommended action: reach out for updated payment method or accept wire.
madhav: last wire we sent had an outdated bank address — I have corrected wiring instructions ready. Need to confirm we can accept wire and mark invoice as paid on receipt.
olivia: can you drop the corrected PDF here, madhav? I'll send to the customer.
madhav: Uploaded: https://files.redwood.internal/wires/curamap-wiring-v2.pdf
support-ops: per billing policy, after 3 consecutive declines we automatically place account on billing hold for 24h. Do we want to override this for CuraMap?
kevin: They're an enterprise prospect with committed usage; recommend manual exception: allow one manual retry after they confirm ACH setup, else put on hold. I can approve fee waiver for same-day ACH bank charges for this invoice only.
olivia: tagging @kevin @madhav — customer asked if we can initiate microdeposit validation from our side (they want next-day confirmation).
madhav: We can request same-day ACH verification via our bank partner for fee ~$25. Need finance approval to cover once.
kevin: I approve covering the fee this time. Customer covers future bank fees. I'll note it in the invoice memo.
finance-bot: Manual retry queued by kevin for invoice_7842 at 1856001250.
support-ops: Noted — removing automatic 24h hold for this account pending retry. CS will be flagged to avoid feature cutoff.
olivia: I'm sending wiring PDF and instructions to their treasury now; asking them to confirm bank address and whether they want wire or ACH.
kevin: After they confirm, I'll run the manual retry or mark wire received when cleared. If retry fails again we'll open collections path in 7 days.
madhav: Also adding a short checklist to the billing note: 1) confirm bank name & address 2) confirm account type (checking) 3) confirm routing number 4) record microdeposit timestamps.
olivia: thanks — will update thread once customer responds.
kevin: If customer chooses wire, ask them to include invoice_7842 in payment reference and send remittance to billing@redwood.ai.
olivia: pinged customer. They've started treasury thread and expect to confirm by EOD PST.
support-ops: I'll monitor and set reminder for collections escalation if not resolved in 7 days.
finance-bot: Reminder scheduled: collections_check for invoice_7842 at 1856600000.
olivia: closing loop here — will post final status when payment clears or we get NACK. :thumbsup:
